items.definition:
a person who plays a musical instrument
My brother is a professional musician.

a small oval fruit; a greenish-brown color
I like olives in my salad.

a carved or cast figure of a person or animal
There is a large statue in the park.

a person aged between 13 and 19 years
My cousin is a teenager.

A woman on her wedding day.
The bride looked beautiful in her white dress.

A motion picture using animation techniques.
My children love watching cartoons on Saturday mornings.

A young bird, especially one newly hatched.
The hen had five fluffy chicks.

A small, imaginary being of human form, with magical powers.
Children often believe in tooth fairies.

hair growing on the chin and cheeks of an adult man
My grandfather has a long white beard.

a roughly cylindrical open container with a handle
He filled the bucket with water from the well.

any of the world's main continuous expanses of land
Africa is the second-largest continent.

a colored fluid used for writing, drawing, or printing
The printer is running low on ink.

a primate typically having a long tail and living in trees
The monkey swung from tree to tree in the jungle.

motorcycle
He rides a powerful motorcycle.

nest
The bird built a nest in the tree.

penny
I found a shiny penny on the sidewalk.

rainbow
After the rain, a beautiful rainbow appeared.

ambulance
An ambulance arrived quickly at the scene.

the back part of the human foot
She wore shoes with high heels.

clothes and linens that need to be washed
I need to do the laundry this weekend.

the direction between north and east
The storm is moving towards the northeast.

a length of strong cord
He tied the boat with a thick rope.

a loud cry
We heard a shout from the crowd.

a mobile phone that performs many of the functions of a computer
I use my smartphone for everything.

a regretful acknowledgment of an offense or failure
He offered a sincere apology.

a small spot or mark
There's a small dot on the map indicating our location.

an enclosed compartment for cooking and heating food
She baked a cake in the oven.

an official document issued by a government, certifying the holder's identity and citizenship
You need a passport to travel internationally.

a small round mass of solid medicine for swallowing whole
He takes a pill every morning for his allergies.

brother or sister
I have one sibling, an older brother.

underground train system
We took the subway to get downtown.

a flat, portable computer
I read books on my tablet.

a portable shelter
We set up our tent by the lake.

the part of a shirt around the neck
He adjusted the collar of his shirt.

a picture or diagram made with a pencil, pen, or crayon
She showed me a beautiful drawing of a landscape.

the distinctive taste of a food or drink
This ice cream has a delicious vanilla flavor.

a covering for the hand
He put on his warm gloves before going outside.

the time in the evening when the sun disappears or daylight fades
We watched the beautiful sunset over the ocean.

woven fabric
She used a damp cloth to wipe the table.

the short, fine, soft hair of certain animals
My cat has very soft fur.

a structure for climbing up or down
He used a ladder to reach the top shelf.

section of text
Please read the first paragraph of the article.

meat from a pig
We had roast pork for dinner.

main stem of a tree or car storage
We put the suitcases in the car trunk.

a book of words and their meanings
I looked up the word in the dictionary.

refrigerator (informal)
Please put the milk back in the fridge.

a common farm animal
A goat was grazing in the field.

a small arthropod animal that has six legs and generally one or two pairs of wings
An insect crawled across the table.

a young sheep
The shepherd carried a tiny lamb.

a flat length of wood or other rigid material, attached to a wall or forming part of a unit, used for storing or displaying objects
She placed the book on the top shelf.

a wild animal's lair or a small, comfortable room
The bear returned to its den.

a son of one's brother or sister
My nephew is visiting next week.

a large, edible fish
I had grilled salmon for dinner.

a person who sells something
The seller offered a good price.

a yellowish-brown color; a darker skin color from sun exposure
She got a nice tan on her vacation.

any of a group of organic compounds that are essential for normal growth and nutrition
Oranges are a good source of Vitamin C.

the activity of spending a holiday living in a tent
We went camping in the mountains.

a person who works in an office or shop and whose job is to keep records or accounts
The hotel clerk checked us in quickly.

a small house, typically in the countryside
They spent their holidays in a charming little cottage.

a powder made from grain, used for making bread, cakes, etc.
You need flour to bake a cake.

the quality of being friendly, generous, and considerate
She showed great kindness to the new student.

a temporary stop in action or speech
There was a brief pause before she continued speaking.

a thin, flat piece cut from something
Would you like another slice of cake?

the act of forming words with letters
Her spelling has improved a lot this year.
